environment.description: Quarkus 3.2 native image deployed as AWS Lambda behind API Gateway (HTTP API, no authorization). RDS PostgreSQL 14 in same VPC with inventory_items table containing sensitive supplier pricing data. Lambda execution role has AmazonS3FullAccess. VPC has standard NAT gateway for outbound. No WAF attached to API Gateway. Database user has SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE on all tables in the schema including users, pricing_secrets, and supplier_contracts.

config.api_gateway: HTTP API, no auth, no WAF
config.vpc: standard VPC with NAT gateway, no endpoint policies
